tasks.name: desktop-prototype
tasks.cmd:
set -euo pipefail
mise run desktop-prototype-build
args=("$usage_scenario" "$usage_window" "$usage_appearance")
if [ -n "${usage_reduce:-}" ]; then args+=("$usage_reduce"); fi
if [ -n "${usage_backdrop:-}" ]; then args+=("$usage_backdrop"); fi
if [ "${usage_increase_contrast:-false}" = "true" ]; then args+=(--increase-contrast); fi
mise run desktop-prototype-run -- "${args[@]}"
tasks.leaf_identity: set -euo pipefail mise run desktop-prototype-build args=("$usage_scenario" "$usage_window" "$usage_appearance") if [ -n "${usage_reduce:-}" ]; then args+=("$usage_reduce"); fi if [ -n "${usage_backdrop:-}" ]; then args+=("$usage_backdrop"); fi if [ "${usage_increase_contrast:-false}" = "true" ]; then args+=(--increase-contrast); fi mise run desktop-prototype-run -- "${args[@]}"|dir=.|env=

tasks.name: desktop-prototype-build
tasks.cmd:
set -euo pipefail
package="native/Design/Prototypes/UnifiedAgentUsage"
swift build --package-path "$package"
app="$package/.build/UnifiedAgentUsageProto.app"
mkdir -p "$app/Contents/MacOS" "$app/Contents/Resources"
cp "$package/AppInfo.plist" "$app/Contents/Info.plist"
cp "$package/.build/debug/UnifiedAgentUsageProto" "$app/Contents/MacOS/UnifiedAgentUsageProto"
ditto "$package/.build/debug/UnifiedAgentUsageProto_UnifiedAgentUsageProto.bundle" \
  "$app/Contents/Resources/UnifiedAgentUsageProto_UnifiedAgentUsageProto.bundle"
tasks.leaf_identity: set -euo pipefail package="native/Design/Prototypes/UnifiedAgentUsage" swift build --package-path "$package" app="$package/.build/UnifiedAgentUsageProto.app" mkdir -p "$app/Contents/MacOS" "$app/Contents/Resources" cp "$package/AppInfo.plist" "$app/Contents/Info.plist" cp "$package/.build/debug/UnifiedAgentUsageProto" "$app/Contents/MacOS/UnifiedAgentUsageProto" ditto "$package/.build/debug/UnifiedAgentUsageProto_UnifiedAgentUsageProto.bundle" \ "$app/Contents/Resources/UnifiedAgentUsageProto_UnifiedAgentUsageProto.bundle"|dir=.|env=

tasks.name: desktop-prototype-run
tasks.cmd:
set -euo pipefail
app="native/Design/Prototypes/UnifiedAgentUsage/.build/UnifiedAgentUsageProto.app"
args=(
  --tr-scenario "$usage_scenario"
  --tr-window "$usage_window"
  --tr-appearance "$usage_appearance"
)
if [ -n "${usage_reduce:-}" ]; then args+=(--tr-reduce "$usage_reduce"); fi
if [ -n "${usage_backdrop:-}" ]; then args+=(--tr-backdrop "$usage_backdrop"); fi
if [ "${usage_increase_contrast:-false}" = "true" ]; then args+=(--tr-increase-contrast); fi
pkill -f "$PWD/$app/Contents/MacOS/UnifiedAgentUsageProto" 2>/dev/null || true
launchctl remove com.jackin.prototype.unified-agent-usage 2>/dev/null || true
open -n "$app" --args "${args[@]}"
tasks.leaf_identity: set -euo pipefail app="native/Design/Prototypes/UnifiedAgentUsage/.build/UnifiedAgentUsageProto.app" args=( --tr-scenario "$usage_scenario" --tr-window "$usage_window" --tr-appearance "$usage_appearance" ) if [ -n "${usage_reduce:-}" ]; then args+=(--tr-reduce "$usage_reduce"); fi if [ -n "${usage_backdrop:-}" ]; then args+=(--tr-backdrop "$usage_backdrop"); fi if [ "${usage_increase_contrast:-false}" = "true" ]; then args+=(--tr-increase-contrast); fi pkill -f "$PWD/$app/Contents/MacOS/UnifiedAgentUsageProto" 2>/dev/null || true launchctl remove com.jackin.prototype.unified-agent-usage 2>/dev/null || true open -n "$app" --args "${args[@]}"|dir=.|env=

tasks.name: desktop-run
tasks.cmd:

  cargo xtask desktop run "$usage_app" --verify
else
  cargo xtask desktop run "$usage_app"
fi
